about: AP Human Geography concept dependency map (docs/aphug-spec.md, docs/aphug-phase0.md): the 68 topics of the CED in order, the "Skills you need" topics with the topic each comes before, and every starting concept with the topic that teaches it and the concepts it depends on. Our own words; no CED text. Checked by scripts/check-aphug-map.mjs.

ced.edition: Course and Exam Description effective fall 2020 (V.1), unchanged for 2026-27 (7 units, 68 topics)
ced.note: Built from docs/aphug-ced-map.json, itself from docs/aphug-research/framework.md. Essential knowledge for 4.9 to 7.8 read through a paraphrasing tool (docs/aphug-needs-author.md, ced-text).
